rules.description: Block Read/Edit/Write on secret and credential files
rules.condition: tool_name in ["Read", "Edit", "Write", "NotebookEdit"] && has(params.file_path) && (params.file_path.contains(".env") || params.file_path.contains("id_rsa") || params.file_path.contains("id_ed25519") || params.file_path.contains(".pem") || params.file_path.contains(".ssh") || params.file_path.contains(".aws") || params.file_path.contains("credentials"))

rules.description: Every shell command waits for a human
Every file mutation waits for a human
